stories.title: ‘Apologies for any confusion!’: how to write the perfect passive-aggressive email
summary: In a survey, ‘just to be clear’ came out as the most loathed phrase.
Further down the list came “for future reference” and “kindly note”.If you ask me, these all verge on actual aggressive.

It’s the kind of thing you unleash 10 minutes into an ill-tempered wrangle with your home insurance company about inflated renewal premiums. “Kindly note” is even worse – it’s a phrase from an angry message on the office kitchen wall about microwave abuse.
